topics.who: Technicians and technicians-in-training living or practicing in Nevada: approved Nevada law CE, no substitutes

rules.notes: Plus, if employed in a Nevada pharmacy: 12 hours of in-service training in the 2 years before renewal, approved and kept by the managing pharmacist (PTCB recertification CE may count). Records stay at the pharmacy; do not send them with the renewal.
rules.rule_quote: Pharmacy technicians living or practicing in NEVADA are required to complete one hour of an approved Nevada Law continuing education (CE) prior to renewal.
